notes.title: Melty Amethyst Now on Steam!
notes.content:
Melty Amethyst Now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3086760/Melty_Amethyst/

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45094082/232462a33f543b1f8dc7422cffc7bcb98643805b.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45094082/1b17552e200d7db737859baef183018f67fc0e73.jpg[/img][/url]

The main heroine went to Tokyo because she admired her older sister, who worked here as a model.
She spends her days working part-time at a convenience store.
She likes working with her fellow friends though, something is missing from her life...
One day, a new friend rushes into her life.

Features:
* Genres: otome, romance, slice of life, visual novel.
* 2 unique endings.
* 4 CG.
* Full voiced
